payload.what_is_unsupported: an exception/disapplication of one clause for a defined class of communications, leaving VOL-I:4.2 text unchanged
payload.why: software limitation: ADD-03:4.4 states that Volume I Clause 4.2 'does not apply' to a class of communications. That is a partial disapplication of a clause that carries disqualification ('Breach of this Clause shall result in the disqualification of the Bidder.'). It is not a text replacement, deletion or status change of VOL-I:4.2, and the annotate op (tried in simulation with target VOL-I:4.2) was reported invalid (C22 'targets exist: []'); no op type represents a scoped exception. Its scope ('to the extent that they concern the identification and handling of cores and records') and its interaction with ADD-03:4.3 is for a person; no_effect is not proposed because the words except.

payload.short: Scope of the VOL-I:4.2 exception for core-store appointments
payload.text: ambiguous: ADD-03:4.4 says 'Volume I Clause 4.2 does not apply to communications with the Authority's geotechnical consultant during an appointment under Section 4.3, to the extent that they concern the identification and handling of cores and records.' VOL-I:4.2 bars contact with any 'consultant or advisor of the Authority' other than through the Portal, on pain of disqualification. Open: (a) whether communications during an appointment on other topics (e.g. ground conditions, interpretation of the Geotechnical Baseline Report) remain barred and so carry disqualification; (b) whether the exception covers anything outside the appointment itself. Decision owner: Legal, with Bid management for conduct at the core store.

ADD-03:4.4 disapplies Volume I Clause 4.2 (a clause carrying disqualification) for a limited class of communications; whether it is an exception, an interpretation or something else, and its exact scope ('to the extent that they concern the identification and handling of cores and records'), is for a person.
